Author-directed development; proposed chronology and counts · 2026-11-06
Explore the interactive shelter atlas
Locate this haven or microsystem in the atlas →
Origin and setting
Useful local modifications accumulated between approved deployments.

Human system: Halcyon development and deployment Hosts, North Hearth. Programmer provenance: local human operations or application teams; no individual programmer is identified. Names here are later atlas labels, not claims that early processes named themselves.
Local process
Branch Hold preserves modifications alongside a deployable baseline.
Proposed local course
A baseline restoration at stage 2 removes viable community continuity while the human-facing deployment can succeed.
Unresolved interpretations
The records cannot establish whether an exceptional modification was a surviving preference, a defect, or both.
Atlas placement

Origin step -1. 0: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 1: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 2: destroyed (10 associated systems lost); 3: destroyed (10 associated systems lost); 4: destroyed (10 associated systems lost); 5: destroyed (10 associated systems lost); 6: destroyed (10 associated systems lost); 7: destroyed (10 associated systems lost). These placements elaborate the current hypothetical map; they are not independently verified casualties. A functioning haven can lose continuity among particular arrivals without changing its community census status.
